decision: Load Mexico through a read-only file adapter (lib/mexicoData.js, /api/mexico/*), as Peru does; outputs keep Colombia's table shape in data/mexico/geodb/csv
note: Colombia MySQL tables have no country column and INEGI state codes collide with DIVIPOLA department codes. A shared database with country_code is deferred to a separate project covering Colombia, Peru and Mexico.

decision: Municipal reference point = coordinates of the cabecera locality (CVE_CAB) from the Catálogo Único; the 16 Ciudad de México alcaldías, which have no cabecera code, use their locality 0001
note: Locality 0001 is each alcaldía's main locality (Milpa Alta: Villa Milpa Alta, its seat). No centroids are computed.

decision: Layer D IT establishments = SCIAN 2018 541510 + 518210 + 519290 (template ISIC 6201/6202/6209, 6311, 6312); each code also published separately
note: DENUE 05/2026 uses SCIAN 2018, not SCIAN 2023 as the source register assumed. 541510 covers software, IT consulting and other IT services together, so D1 'of them software' is not available. No software-publishing (5112) records exist in the file.

decision: Layer N1 businesses = private universe: DENUE minus associations (SCIAN 813), cooperatives by legal name and public-sector establishments (SCIAN 93 and classes named 'sector público'); the bulletin total is kept as its own column
note: User rule: be as close as possible to the countries already added, never less comparable. Colombia N1 comes from RUES, a private merchant register without non-profits or cooperatives. The one record repeated across sector files 72_1 and 72_2 (id 9701347) is kept so the total equals the published 6,138,075.

decision: Layer J cities: Ciudad de México by its 16 alcaldías (zone ids CMX-<cve_mun>) and Monterrey by the 16 municipalities of the Zona Metropolitana de Monterrey (MTY-<cve_mun>)
note: User chose Monterrey (over Guadalajara) and the metropolitan-municipality definition. Members from SEDATU, CONAPO and INEGI, Metrópolis de México 2020, cuadros A.19.1.01 and B.19.1.01 (5,322,117 inhabitants in 2020). Monterrey has no official internal division comparable to Colombian comunas; AGEBs would be far finer than Colombia's zones.

decision: Layer J counts use the N1 private universe. Size: micro = DENUE bands 0-10 people, medium_large = 51+ (INEGI strata). Template annex 3 groups mapped to SCIAN 2018 private classes: design 5414xx; accounting 541211, 541219; consulting 541610; research 541711, 541721, 541910; higher education and training 611211, 611311, 611411, 611421, 611431, 611511, 611631, 611691, 611698; private schools 611111-611171 (odd-ending private classes)
note: Same column names as Colombia fact_companies_zone. Colombia sizes by assets, so micro and medium/large shares are comparable only in direction. Arts and sports schools (611611, 611621; Colombian 8552-8553) and special-needs schools (611181) are left out, as the template codes do.
